about: The queen gathers her court and tells them why she must go: she loves wisdom more than gold, honey or light, and having heard of Solomon she loves him unseen. Her nobles and servants vow to share her life and death. She sets out with a great caravan, trusting in God (compare 1 Kings 10, Proverbs 8, Wisdom of Solomon 6–7).

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፳፬ is 20 + 4 = 24. ኀበ is the conjunction 'where' (as in the headings of ch. 17–19, 23), so 'Where she made ready to go' means the place or occasion of her setting out. ተደለወት is the 3fs perfect of ተደለወ 'be prepared, make ready' (the ተ- Gt stem, here with a reflexive sense); ለሐዊር is ለ- 'to' + the infinitive ሐዊር 'going' (of ሖረ), the usual way to say 'in order to go'.

sentences.l: And-she-said-to-them: hear (you) word-my, [ʾəliʾäya?], and-incline-ear-also speech-my;
sentences.i: And she said to them: 'Hear my word, and give ear to my speech;
sentences.n: ወትቤሎሙ 'and she said to them' (ወ- + ትቤ, the 3fs perfect of the irregular verb 'say', + ሎሙ 'to them'). ስምዑ is the 2mp imperative of ሰምዐ 'hear'. ቃልየ 'my word' (ቃል + -የ 'my'). I cannot identify እሊአየ: it sits beside ቃልየ as a doublet and carries the same -የ 'my', so I read it as another word for 'my saying', but I have left it out of the free translation (uncertain). ወአፅምኡኒ: 2mp imperative of አጽመአ 'incline the ear, listen', with ወ- 'and' and the enclitic -ኒ 'also, and'; ነገርየ 'my speech'. The queen's speech to her court begins here and runs to the ፨ after ch. 24's praise of wisdom; its parallel lines in pairs (word // speech) are the usual shape of Semitic exhortation.

sentences.tr: ʾəsmä ʾänsä ʾəfäqd ṭəbäbä wälbəyäni täḫäśśa läʾäʾməro
sentences.l: for I-as-for I-desire wisdom, and-heart-my-also it-seeks-her(?) for-knowledge;
sentences.i: for I, for my part, desire wisdom, and my heart too seeks after knowledge (?);
sentences.n: እስመ 'for' opens each line of the opening of the speech (flagged here, then nudged). አንሰ 'as for me' (አነ + the contrastive -ሰ, which sets her against others). እፈቅድ 'I desire, love' (1cs imperfect of ፈቀደ). ጥበበ is the accusative of ጥበብ 'wisdom'. ወልብየኒ 'and my heart also' (ወ- + ልብ + -የ 'my' + -ኒ 'also'). ተኀሥሣ: the form is unclear. I read it as a verb of ኀሠሠ 'seek' with -ኣ 'her' ('it seeks her'), but a ተ- prefix on a 3ms subject is not what the active verb would show (ተኀሥሠ, the ተ- stem, means 'be sought'), so it may be a miswriting of ይኅሥሣ (?); ለአእምሮ 'for knowledge' (ለ- + አእምሮ). The sense 'the heart seeks knowledge' is clear either way.

sentences.i: for wisdom is better than a treasury of gold and silver;
sentences.n: ትኄይስ 'she is better' (3fs imperfect of ኀየሰ 'be good, better'; ጥበብ is feminine, so the verb takes ት-). እመዝገበ is እም- 'than, from' + መዝገብ 'treasure, store' in the construct state (መዝገበ ወርቅ 'storehouse of gold'). The comparison of wisdom with gold and silver is the stock opening of the wisdom tradition: Proverbs 3:14 and 8:10–11, Wisdom of Solomon 7:8–9. This whole speech is built on it, and the queen is praising what she is about to go and seek in Solomon.

sentences.n: A question. በምንትኬ 'with what, then' (በ- + ምንት 'what' + the enclitic -ኬ 'then, indeed'). ያስተማስልዋ 'they liken her' (3mp imperfect of አስተማሰለ 'make like, compare', + -ዋ 'her'); the object is repeated by ለጥበብ 'to wisdom', the same anticipating suffix flagged in ch. 21–23. The subject is impersonal ('one'), so 'can wisdom be compared' is a fair rendering. በታሕተ ሰማይ 'under heaven' (ታሕተ 'beneath').

sentences.i: She is sweeter than honey, she gladdens more than wine, she gives more light than the sun, she is more loved than a precious stone, she shelters (?) more than oil, she satisfies more than sweet dishes, and she brings more honour than thousands of gold and silver;
sentences.n: A list of seven comparisons with እምነ 'than', all verbs 3fs imperfect with ት- because ጥበብ is feminine. ትጥዕም 'she is sweet' (ጠዐመ). ታስተፌሥሕ 'she gladdens' (አስተፈሥሐ, causative). ታበርህ 'she gives light, shines' (አብርሀ). ትትፈቀር 'she is loved' (ተፈቀረ, passive of ፈቀረ). ታጠልል: I take it as the causative (አጠለለ) of ጠለለ 'give shade, shelter', but 'shelter more than ointment' is a strange pairing and I am not sure of the word (?). ታጸግብ 'she satisfies' (አጸገበ, causative of ጸገበ 'be sated'). ታከብር 'she honours, makes glorious' (አክበረ). መባልዕት ጥዑማት 'sweet dishes' (plural noun + plural adjective). አእላፍ is the plural of አልፍ 'thousand', so 'thousands'. The comparison with honey, wine, precious stones, oil and gold is the praise of the Law in Psalm 19:10 and of wisdom in Proverbs 8 and Wisdom of Solomon 7.

sentences.i: A gladdener of the heart, a light for the eyes, a [käwaw] (?) for the foot, armour for the stranger, a [gera] (?) for the head, a collar (?) for the neck, a girdle for the loins, a hearing for the ears, a teacher of wisdom (?) for the hearts, instruction for the learned, a comforter for the prudent, and a giver of honour to those who seek her.
sentences.n: The list continues as predicate nouns, with no verb: 'she is …'. The first two, in -ት, are feminine agent nouns agreeing with ጥበብ; the others show no gender. መስተፈሥሒት 'gladdener' and መብርሂት 'illuminator, giver of light' are መ- agent nouns from the same roots as the verbs of the previous unit. Each ለ- 'for' names who benefits (ለልብ, ለአዕይንት 'for the eyes'), a pattern of body parts and what protects or adorns them. Words I could not settle: ከዋው ለእግር (the sense 'something for the foot' fits, a sandal or support, but the word is unidentified; I leave it bracketed); ጌራ ለርእስ (something for the head, a crown or garland; unidentified); ብዝጋና ለክሳድ ('a collar for the neck', a guess from the parallel); ድርዕ 'armour' (ድርዕ is a coat of mail or shield); ለእንግድኣ 'for the stranger' (እንግዳ, here with the odd ending -ኣ). መቀነቲ 'girdle' for the loins (ሐቌ, plural ሐቌያት). መጥበቢ I read as the agent noun of the causative አጥበበ 'make wise' (as መብርሂ is of አብርሀ), so 'one who makes wise, a teacher of wisdom' (?). ማእምራን 'knowers, the learned'; መናዘዚ 'comforter' (from ናዘዘ), ልቡባን 'the prudent'; ወሃቤ ክብር 'giver of honour' (construct chain), ለኀሣሥያን 'to seekers' (ኀሣሢ 'seeker', plural -ያን).

sentences.i: Neither does a kingdom stand without wisdom, nor is wealth kept safe without wisdom, nor is the foot firm where it walks without wisdom, nor is the tongue that speaks loved without wisdom.
sentences.n: Four parallel clauses, each ወX-ኒ ኢ-verb ዘእንበለ ጥበብ. The -ኒ attached to the subject ('kingdom-also') carries 'also, even' and with ኢ- gives 'neither … nor'. ዘእንበለ 'without' (here with a plain noun, ዘእንበለ ጥበብ 'without wisdom'); flagged once, then nudged. ኢይቀውም 'it does not stand' (ቆመ); ኢይትዐቀብ 'is not guarded' (ተዐቀበ, passive of ዐቀበ); ኢይጸንዕ 'is not firm, strong' (ጸንዐ); ኀበ ኬደ 'where it walked' (ኬደ 3ms perfect of ከይደ 'tread, walk'); ዘተናገረ 'which spoke, that speaks' (a relative clause qualifying ልሳን 'tongue'). The speech returns to wisdom as the condition of kingship, which is the theme that carries the whole chapter.

sentences.n: ወዘዘገበ ጥበበ 'and he who stored up wisdom' (ዘ- relative before the perfect). አልቦ 'there is not' (negative existential). ዘየሀይዶ 'who drives him away' (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect of ሀየደ 'plunder, carry off' (the verb of ሀያዲ 'robber' in the published glossary) + the 3ms object suffix -o, which fuses with the final ድ as ዶ); the suffix may mean 'him' or 'it' (wisdom), so the sentence can mean 'none can take wisdom from his heart' or 'none can plunder him of his heart's desire'. I take the first. The ወ- of ወዘዘገበ is the 'but' contrasting with the previous line.

sentences.i: What fools have stored up (?), the wise eat; because of the evil of the wicked the righteous are praised, and because of the error of fools the wise are loved.
sentences.n: ወዘዘገኩ አብዳን 'and what the fools stored': ዘዘገኩ looks like ዘ- + a form of ዘገበ, but ዘገኩ (a 1cs ending) cannot be right after 'fools'; I read it as a corrupt or variant form of ዘዘገቡ (3mp) and mark it uncertain (?). The saying that the wise inherit what fools gather echoes Proverbs 13:22 and Ecclesiastes 2:26. ይበልዑ 'they eat' (3mp imperfect of በልዐ). ጠቢባን, ጻድቃን, አብዳን, ዐማፅያን are plural nouns used as persons (the -ān plurals ጠቢባን, ጻድቃን, አብዳን and the -yān plural ዐማፅያን, of ጠቢብ, ጻድቅ, አብድ, ዐማፂ). ወበእንተ 'and on account of'; እከዮሙ ለዐማፅያን 'their evil, of the wicked' (the suffix -ሙ anticipates the possessor named with ለ-, the pattern flagged in ch. 21–23). ይትዌደሱ 'they are praised' (ተወድሰ, passive of ወደሰ), ይትፈቀሩ 'they are loved' (passive of ፈቀረ); the verbs mean that the wise and righteous are exalted by contrast with the folly around them. ስሐተት 'error, fault'.

sentences.i: Wisdom is exalted and rich. I love her as a mother, and she embraces me as a child. I follow the tracks of wisdom, and she guards me for ever. I seek wisdom, and she will be mine for good (?). I follow her tracks, and one is not cast away from her (?). I lean on her (?), and she will be for me a [ṭəqm] (?) of the world's ends; I find protection in her (?), and she will be my strength and power; I rejoice in her, and she will be for me abundant grace.
sentences.n: The longest unit of the chapter, kept whole because it has no ፤ to cut at. It is a chain of paired clauses of the form 'I do X to her — and she does Y to me'. ልዕልት and ብዕልት are the feminine adjectives 'exalted' and 'rich'; ይእቲ 'she'; አነ ኣፈቅራ 'I love her' (አነ + 1cs imperfect of አፍቀረ, with the ኣ- of the causative stem, + -ኣ 'her'). The imperfects ተሐቅፈኒ 'she embraces me' and ተዐቅበኒ 'she guards me' are 3fs forms spelled with ተ- (the expected form is ት-), with -ኒ 'me'. ከመ 'as, like'. እተሉ አሠራ 'I follow her tracks' (ተለወ 'follow'; አሠር 'footprint, track'), with ለጥበብ naming the 'her'. ለዝሉፉ: I cannot identify ዝሉፉ; it looks related to ዘልፈ 'continually' and I give 'for good' with a query (?). ኢይትገደፍ 'is not cast away' (ተገድፈ, passive of ገደፈ 'cast off'), subject unclear. ኣሰምክ ባቲ 'I lean on her' (my reading of ሰምከ 'lean, rest', uncertain (?); the ኣ- would again point to a causative stem); ጥቅመ አድማስ 'a [ṭəqmä] of the ends (አድማስ) of the earth': ጥቅመ is unidentified and I leave it bracketed (?). እጸወን ባቲ 'I find protection in her' (my reading of ጸወነ 'shelter, protect', uncertain (?)). ኀይለ ወጽንዐ 'strength and might' (accusatives); እትፌሣሕ ባቲ 'I rejoice in her' (1cs imperfect of ተፈሥሐ); ሞገሰ ብዙኀ 'abundant grace' (ሞገስ 'grace, favour'). The whole is the sage's pledge in Proverbs 4:6–9 and 8:17: 'I love those who love me'.

sentences.i: for it is right that we follow the tracks of wisdom, and that one wear down his soles (?) at the threshold of wisdom's doors;
sentences.n: እስመ ርቱዕ 'for it is right' (ርቱዕ 'right, fitting', an adjective used as a predicate), then ንትሉ 'that we follow' (1cp subjunctive). ይልካእ ሰኰናነ: I read ይልካእ as 3ms jussive 'let him wear out' and ሰኰናነ as the accusative of ሰኰና 'sole, hoof'; the verb is not one I can confirm (?). The picture of wearing down the threshold of wisdom's doors recalls Proverbs 8:34 ('watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors') and Ben Sira 6:36. መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'threshold-of her doors' (construct chain; ኆኃቲሃ 'her doors', a plural of ኆኅት 'door' with -ሃ 'her'), then ለጥበብ naming the 'her', the usual anticipation.

sentences.n: First-person plural jussives with ን- and -ኣ 'her': ንኅሥሣ 'let us seek her', ንረክባ 'let us find her' (ረከበ), ናፍቅራ 'let us love her' (አፍቀረ), ንዴግና 'let us follow her' (the written ዴ points to a verb ዴገነ, not ደገነ; uncertain (?)), ንስአላ 'let us ask her', ንነሥኣ 'let us take her'. ኢትርሕቅ 'that she not be far' (3fs jussive, a result clause in this chain). The thought is that of Wisdom of Solomon 6:12–16 ('she is easily seen by those who love her and found by those who seek her') and Matthew 7:7 ('ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find'); I name them as echoes only.

sentences.n: ንሚጥ ልበነ 'let us turn our heart' (1cp jussive of ሜጠ 'turn'; ልበነ 'our heart'). ከመ ኢንርስዓ 'so that we not forget her' (ረሰዐ). በኴሉ ጊዜ 'at every time'. ለእመ 'if' (a conditional). ዘከርዋ 'they remember her' (3mp perfect + -ዋ); ትዜክር 'she remembers' (3fs imperfect of ዘከረ; ዜ is the regular spelling of this imperfect), ለሊሃ 'she herself'. sentences.i: For to honour wisdom is to honour the wise man, and to love wisdom is to love the wise man;
sentences.n: ወክብራሰ ለጥበብ 'and as for her honour, that of wisdom' (ክብር + -ኣ 'her' + the contrastive -ሰ; the suffix anticipates ለጥበብ, the pattern flagged in ch. 21–23), and ወፍቅራኒ 'and her love also' likewise. አክብሮ is the infinitive 'honouring'; አፍቅሮቱ is the verbal noun አፍቅሮት 'loving' + -ሁ 'his' (as ነገሩ is ነገር + -ሁ), the suffix anticipating ለጠቢብ. ጠቢብ 'wise man'. The claim is that honouring wisdom means honouring those who have it, which prepares for the queen's own journey.

sentences.i: Listen to what his mouth discloses, that you may be like him; and watch the tread of his feet, that you may set your foot where he has walked; and do not hold back from him, that you may take the remnants of his wisdom.
sentences.n: A run of imperatives and ከመ 'that' clauses. ስማዕ 'hear' (2ms imperative of ሰምዐ); መክሥተ አፉሁ 'the opening of his mouth' (መክሥት 'disclosure, opening', in the construct; አፉሁ 'his mouth', where አፍ takes the stem አፉ- before a suffix). ትኩን 'that you be' (2ms jussive of ኮነ). ርኢ 'see' (imperative of ርእየ); መከይደ እገሪሁ 'the tread of his feet' (መከይድ is a noun from ከይደ 'walk'; the exact sense is uncertain (?); እገሪሁ 'his feet'). ታንብር 'that you set' (አንበረ 'place'), with no object stated; I supply 'your foot'. ኀበ ኬደ ውእቱ 'where he walked' (ውእቱ 'he', resumptive and emphatic). ኢትሰስል 'do not slacken, hold back' (ሰሰለ; my reading, uncertain (?)). ተረፋተ ጥበቡ 'the remnants of his wisdom' (ተረፍ 'remainder', plural ተረፋት, accusative; ጥበቡ 'his wisdom'). Here the praise becomes personal: the queen pictures herself as the disciple of the wise king, which is the logic of the journey.

glossary.ወኢታፈቅሮሙ: አፍቀረ — and she does not love them (ወ- + ኢ- + 3fs imperfect + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወኢትርሐቅ: ርሕቀ — and do not be far (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms jussive)
glossary.ወኢትርሕቅ: ርሕቀ — and she will not be far (ወ- + ኢ- + 3fs jussive)
glossary.ወኢትሰስል: ሰሰለ — and do not slacken, hold back (?) (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms jussive; uncertain)
glossary.ወኢይትገደፍ: ተገድፈ — and it is not cast away (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, passive of ገደፈ)
glossary.ወእመኒ: እመ — and if indeed, and whether (ወ- + እመ + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወእግርኒ: እግር — and the foot also (ወ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወከዋው: ከዋው — and [käwaw] (?) something for the foot (ወ- + unidentified noun; uncertain)
glossary.ወክብራሰ: ክብር — and as for her honour (ወ- + noun + -ኣ '3fs her' + contrastive -ሰ; ለጥበብ names the possessor)
glossary.ወወሃቤ: ወሃቢ — and giver of (ወ- + agent noun, construct ወሃቤ)
glossary.ወዓርትዐት: አርትዐ — and she made straight (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative, spelled ዓርትዐ)
glossary.ወዓድግ: ዐድግ — and asses (ወ- + collective noun, spelled ዓድግ)
glossary.ወዘዘገበ: ዘገበ — and he who stored up (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወዘዘገኩ: ዘገበ — and what ... stored (?) (ወ- + ዘ- + a form with 1cs ending -ኩ, perhaps for 3mp ዘገቡ; uncertain)
glossary.ወይልካእ: ልክአ — and let him wear down (?) (ወ- + 3ms jussive; verb uncertain)
glossary.ወይቤልዋ: ይቤ — and they said to her (ወ- + 3mp perfect of the irregular verb 'say' + -ልዋ 'to her')
glossary.ወድርዕ: ድርዕ — and armour, coat of mail (ወ- + noun)
glossary.ወጌራ: ጌራ — and [gera] (?) something for the head (ወ- + unidentified noun; uncertain)
glossary.ወጽህቀት: ጽህቀ — and [ṣəḥqät] (?) unidentified (ወ- + apparent 3fs perfect of an unplaced root ጽሕቀ; uncertain)
glossary.ወጽንዐ: ጽንዕ — and might (ወ- + noun, accusative ጽንዐ)
glossary.ወፍቅራኒ: ፍቅር — and her love also (ወ- + noun + -ኣ '3fs her' + enclitic -ኒ 'also'; ለጥበብ names the possessor)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
glossary.ዘተናገረ: ተናገረ — which spoke, that speaks (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, reciprocal ተ- stem of ነገረ)
glossary.ዘተፈጥረ: ተፈጥረ — which was created (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ፈጠረ)
glossary.ዘታፈቅሪ: አፍቀረ — (that) you love (ዘ- + 2fs imperfect, causative; construction obscure (?))
glossary.ዘአልቦ: አልቦ — which has not, there is not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'not-with-him', negative existential)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her')
glossary.ዘከርዋ: ዘከረ — they mentioned her (3mpl perfect, G, 'remember, mention' + -ዋ 3fs object suffix) · they remember her (ለእመ ዘከርዋ ትዜክር 'if they remember her, she remembers')
glossary.ዘዘገበ: ዘገበ — he who stored up (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G; verb unconfirmed (?))
glossary.ዘየሀይዶ: ሀየደ — who plunders, carries off him or it (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect + -o '3ms him, it'; the ድ + ኦ is written ዶ)
glossary.ዚዓሁ: ዚአሁ — his own, his (possessive pronoun 3ms; spelled ዚዓሁ)
glossary.ያስተማስልዋ: አስተማሰለ — they liken her, compare her (3mp imperfect, causative-reflexive + -ዋ 'her')
glossary.ይትዌከል: ተወከለ — he trusts, relies (3ms imperfect, Gt; with a female subject perhaps a slip for ትትዌከል (?))
glossary.ይትዌደሱ: ተወድሰ — they are praised (3mp imperfect, passive of ወደሰ)
glossary.ይትፈቀሩ: ተፈቀረ — they are loved (3mp imperfect, tä-stem passive of ፈቀረ)
glossary.ጠቢብ: ጠቢብ — wise, a wise man (adjective used as noun)
glossary.ጥቅመ: ጥቅም — [ṭəqmä] (?) unidentified (noun, accusative or construct; uncertain)
glossary.ጥበቢሁ: ጥበብ — his wisdom (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his'; the suffix anticipates the possessor named with ለ-) · plain 'his wisdom' with no ለ- phrase following (ከመ ትስማዕ ጥበቢሁ 'that she may hear his wisdom')
glossary.ጥበብሰ: ጥበብ — wisdom, as for her (noun, fem. + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ፈተወ: ፈተወ — he wished, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ፍትወ: ፍትወት — desire, longing (noun; ፍትወ is not the regular accusative of ፍትወት, so perhaps ፍትው (?))
glossary.፯፻ወ፺: ፯፻ወ፺ — spoken ሰብዐቱ ምእት ወተስዓ (säbʿätu məʾət wä-täsʿa) 'seven hundred and ninety' (numeral)
